lead: Sachin Tendulkar has built a public profile as an Indian cricketer, born on 24 April 1973 in Mumbai.
As of 2026, he is 53 years old, and his birth date places him under the Taurus sign.
He has represented Mumbai cricket team and India national cricket team and has held the office of member of Rajya Sabha.
The sections that follow break down Sachin Tendulkar's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Sachin Tendulkar — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Sachin Tendulkar was born on 24 April 1973 in Mumbai, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Ramesh Tendulkar.
He studied at Kirti M.Doongursee College.
He is recorded as speaking Marathi and English.

sections.heading: Sachin Tendulkar — Career and Professional Work
paras: Sachin Tendulkar works primarily as a cricketer and politician.

On the team sheet, Sachin has been associated with Mumbai cricket team (from 1988 to 2013), India national cricket team (from 1989 to 2013), Cricket Club of India (from 1988 to 1988), Yorkshire County Cricket Club (from 1992 to 1992), Mumbai Indians (from 2008 to 2013) and Marylebone Cricket Club (from 1989 to 2014). He plays as a batter.
He has held the following offices: member of Rajya Sabha (2012–2018).
He has taken part in 1998 Commonwealth Games.
